baseline_tools.name: get_issue
baseline_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread. Use when you already know the issue ID; use list_issues or search_issues to discover issues. Read-only. Output format is not otherwise documented in source.

id.description: ID of the issue to fetch, in the form TRK-117. Required.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: List issues, optionally filtered by status or assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues by those fields; use search_issues for free-text matching, or get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Read-only. Output format is not documented in source.

assignee.description: Filter issues by assignee. Free-form string; the expected identifier format is not defined in source. Optional; no filter if omitted.

include_comments.description: Whether to include comments with each issue. Optional; source defines no default. Leaving it unset or false is the more economical choice for smaller responses, since comments likely increase payload size.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return. Optional; source defines no default or maximum. Use a small value to keep responses compact.

status.description: Filter issues by status. Free-form string; allowed values are not defined in source. Optional; no filter if omitted.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Search issues by a free-text query. Use when you need to find issues by keywords rather than filtering by status or assignee; use list_issues for filtered browsing, or get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Read-only. Output format and query syntax are not documented in source.

include_comments.description: Whether to include comments in search results. Optional; source defines no default. Leaving it unset or false is the more economical choice for smaller responses, since comments likely increase payload size.

query.description: Free-text search query for issues. Required. Query syntax is not defined in source.
